title: PriceList
$comment: One schedule, on consensus before it is charged, the same for everyone (§4.5, §14.3, D-101). A message on the Postmaster’s price topic, memo `wishmail:prices:1`, sole submit key the Postmaster’s. The numbers are a deployment’s, not this specification’s (Q-6, §19.2). T-P11-4, T-P11-2. AUTHORED object (§5.1): produced by an actor and validated against this schema. STUB. Tracks §5 of WISHMAIL_SPEC_v0_5.md field for field. Not yet registered under HCS-13: spec/pins.json registeredSchemas is null for this object (T-P9-4, T-P9-9). The specification leads, the schema follows, the tests are the court: where a constraint below is not expressible in JSON Schema, the named test is what holds it.

ledgerTag.description: Ledger tag (§5.1). The core defines exactly these two and refuses every other; an extension that claims another ledger widens this enum (§16.7).
ledgerTag.$comment: T-P9-11 — an envelope whose AAD names an undefined ledger tag is rejected at send and appraises unbound at replay.

method.description: §6.3, §14.2. A release claiming the spending-cap extension (§16.4) widens this enum.

payTo.description: The Postmaster’s receiving address (§14.2). Present on every method; a method settled through a facilitator carries both (§14.3, D-136).

facilitator.description: The facilitator that settles this leg, where one does (§14.2).

unitPrice.description: The price of one stamp in the method’s asset, as a decimal string in that asset’s natural unit — never atomic units, never a JSON number (§14.3, D-136). Absent on a rate-priced method.

bundles.description: A price for a count, offered to everyone alike (§4.5, §14.3). A bundle’s price follows its method’s pricing basis: the method’s own asset where the method is fixed-priced, the reference asset where it is rate-priced (§14.3, D-136).

amount.description: The price of one stamp in the reference asset, as a decimal string (§14.3, D-136).

asset.description: The reference asset the rate converts from.

rate.description: For a method priced by reference to another asset (§14.2, §14.3). Carried in place of `unitPrice`; `source` and `pair` name what the Postmaster reads at purchase to convert `reference` into the amount it quotes.

items.$comment: §14.3's two pipes are read differently, and D-136 records why. `payTo | facilitator` is INCLUSIVE — §14.2 has the PAYMENT-REQUIRED carry the Postmaster's receiving address, which is `payTo`, so an x402 method needs it alongside `facilitator`, not instead of it — hence anyOf. `unitPrice | rate` is EXCLUSIVE — a method priced two ways publishes a number nobody charges, which §14.3's own MUST forbids — hence oneOf.

provisioning.description: The provisioned path (§4.6), if offered. Provisioning is never required (§4.6, D-57).
